feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: This year's El Nino is forecast to reach the strongest level recorded since 1950
entry.summary: The US Climate Prediction Center's 8 October outlook puts the Nino 3.4 ocean-temperature index at 2.1 degrees Celsius above normal, up from 1.8 a month earlier. — Sources: US Climate Prediction Center, ENSO Diagnostic Discussion, 8 October 2026

entry.title: Malaysia's haze reading overtook Singapore's as the region's worst this week
entry.summary: 28 areas across Malaysia recorded unhealthy air quality by 6 October, with Johor's Batu Pahat reaching an Air Pollutant Index of 194. — Sources: The Vibes/Malay Mail, 6 October 2026 · National Environment Agency, Singapore, 9 October 2026

entry.title: Qatar closed 388 work sites for violating its summer heat-work ban
entry.summary: Qatar's Ministry of Labour closed 388 work sites found in violation of the rule requiring all outdoor work to stop once heat crosses a set threshold, for violations recorded between June and September 2026. — Sources: Qatar News Agency, 24 September 2026
